In the headlines: “Sensex, Nifty snap four-week winning streak amid rupee weakness, rising crude oil prices” (Moneycontrol.com). “Sensex Crashes 989 Points, Nifty Falls Below 25,650: Why In…” (theopenpress.in).
One session says little about the long run. Oil, the Iran war and foreign flows remain the big swing factors.

drivers.p: Brent is up 3.8% in a week. India imports most of its crude, so costlier oil can push up inflation, weigh on the rupee and squeeze margins for oil users.
The rupee is at 92.99 per dollar, weaker than a week ago. A weak rupee helps exporters like IT but raises import costs.
